source: Clark T, et al. "AI-readiness Criteria for Biomedical Data." bioRxiv 2024. doi:10.1101/2024.10.23.619844 (first posted as "AI-readiness for Biomedical Data: Bridge2AI Recommendations")
disclaimer: These are simplified proxy measures for exploration, not an official evaluation.
banner: FULL C2M2 DATAPACKAGE from data_real/lincs/ - these scores reflect this one submitted release, measured with our simplified proxies.

checks.description: Records with a persistent ID (persistent_id field, or a persistent-identifier access_url on files)
checks.detail: 1,509,897 of 2,964,650 records have no persistent identifier recorded (1,454,753 have one in persistent_id; 0 more files have one only in access_url; 42,492 persistent_id values use a non-persistent scheme and are not counted)
checks.why_it_matters: Persistent identifiers let a training set be cited and re-assembled later, which supports reproducible models.

checks.description: Ontology-coded field values that are real term IDs (PREFIX:ID), not free text
checks.detail: 10,154,278 of 10,154,278 ontology-field values use a term ID
checks.why_it_matters: Ontology term IDs let values be matched reliably across programs ('Breast' in one, 'UBERON:0000310' in another), so a model sees one concept as one feature.

checks.detail: 1,467,960 of 2,964,650 records have no creation_time recorded
checks.why_it_matters: Timestamps help identify which version of the data a model used and make batch or time effects detectable.

checks.description: Files with a sha256 or md5 checksum
checks.detail: 0 of 1,495,871 files have no checksum recorded
checks.why_it_matters: Checksums let users verify that a downloaded file is exactly the one a model was trained on.

checks.detail: 275 of 275 subjects have no sex recorded
checks.why_it_matters: Recording sex lets model developers check whether results hold for both sexes; NIH's Sex as a Biological Variable policy applies to human and animal studies alike.

checks.description: Single-organism subjects with an age recorded (age_at_enrollment, or age_at_sampling on a linked biosample)
checks.detail: 275 of 275 subjects have no age recorded (0 have age_at_enrollment; 0 more have age_at_sampling on a linked biosample)
checks.why_it_matters: Recording age lets model developers check whether results differ across age groups, such as children and adults.

checks.detail: 15,190 of 1,466,796 biosamples have no anatomy recorded
checks.why_it_matters: Recording anatomy lets a model keep tissue-specific signals apart instead of mixing samples from different tissues.

info: 1,527 cell-line and 164 synthetic subjects excluded from sex/age checks (these checks apply to single-organism subjects, human or animal)
1,211,291 disease associations in this release (1,211,094 in biosample_disease.tsv, 197 in subject_disease.tsv) - not scored, since not every program studies a disease
Characterization.observation: 275 of 275 subjects have no sex recorded. Recording sex lets model developers check whether results hold for both sexes; NIH's Sex as a Biological Variable policy applies to human and animal studies alike.

checks.description: Distinct ontology term IDs with a human-readable label (from the package's own term tables, or portal-sourced in term_labels.py)
checks.detail: 131 of 131 term IDs have a label (datapackage term table or portal); breakdown: 131 datapackage ('DOID:0060058', 'DOID:0070004', 'DOID:10286', 'DOID:1107', 'DOID:1240', ... (126 more))
checks.why_it_matters: Human-readable labels let reviewers sanity-check what a model's input features mean.

Ethics.reason: This reflects the C2M2 schema, not the program: C2M2 has no fields for consent, data use limitations, IRB approval, or governance, so ethics cannot be measured from C2M2 metadata. Each program's own data use documentation is the place to look.

checks.description: Files with a persistent_id or access_url
checks.detail: 0 of 1,495,871 files have no persistent_id or access_url recorded
checks.why_it_matters: A persistent ID or access URL on each file keeps it findable for the models and benchmarks that depend on it.

checks.detail: 0 of 1,495,871 files have no file_format recorded
checks.why_it_matters: A declared file format lets pipelines parse each file without guessing.

checks.description: Croissant metadata generated and passes validate_croissant.py (yes=100 / no=0)
checks.detail: Croissant generated for this program's records and passed validate_croissant.py
checks.why_it_matters: Valid Croissant metadata lets ML tools discover and load the dataset automatically.
